original: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma veluvane kalandakanivāse |
analyzed: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma veluvane kalandaka nivāse

original: tena khalu punaḥ samayena dīrghanakhaparivrājako nāma brāhmaṇo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ, upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ purato daṇḍam avaṣṭabhya bhagavantam etad avocat |
analyzed: tena khalu punar samayena dīrghanakhaparivrājakaḥ nāma brāhmaṇaḥ yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntaḥ upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ puratas daṇḍam avaṣṭabhya bhagavantam etat avocat

original: satyaṃ bho gautama evaṃ vadasi karmasvako lokaḥ karmadāyādaḥ karmayoniḥ karmabandhuḥ karmapratisaraṇa iti |
analyzed: satyam bho gautama evam vadasi karma svakaḥ lokaḥ karma dāyādaḥ karma yoniḥ karma bandhuḥ karma pratisaraṇaḥ iti

original: bhagavān āha | evam eva mahābrāhmaṇa | evaṃ vadāmi karmasvako lokaḥ karmadāyādaḥ karmayoniḥ karmabandhuḥ karmapratiśaraṇa iti |
analyzed: bhagavān āha evam eva mahābrāhmaṇaḥ evam vadāmi karma svakaḥ lokaḥ karma dāyādaḥ karma yoniḥ karma bandhuḥ karma pratiśaraṇaḥ iti

original: brāhmaṇa āha | yad vadasi, kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamo vajrakāyaśarīrasamanvāgataḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha yat vadasi kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ vajra kāya śarīra samanvāgataḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau prāṇātipātaṃ prahāya prāṇātipātāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau prāṇa atipātam prahāya prāṇa atipātāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamo dīrghāṅgulijālāvanaddhahastaḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ dīrgha aṅguli jāla avanaddha hastaḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattāv adattādānaṃ prahāyādattādānāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau adatta ādānam prahāya adatta ādānāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamaḥ paripūrṇendriyaḥ paripūrṇagātraḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ paripūrṇa indriyaḥ paripūrṇa gātraḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau kāmamithyācāraṃ prahāya kāmamithyācārāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau kāma mithyā ācāram prahāya kāma mithyā ācārāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamas trīṇy āsanāny upabhuṅkte 'śeṣāsanāni pravarāsanāny uttamāsanāni |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ trīṇi āsanāni upabhuṅkte śeṣa āsanāni pravara āsanāni uttama āsanāni

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattāv uccaśayanamahāśayanaṃ prahāyoccaśayanamahāśayanāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau ucca śayana mahā śayanam prahāya ucca śayana mahā śayanāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamo jihvayā sarvamukhamaṇḍalam ācchādayati yāvat keśaparyantam |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ jihvayā sarva mukha maṇḍalam ācchādayati yāvat keśa paryantam

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau mṛṣāvādaṃ prahāya mṛṣāvādāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau mṛṣāvādam prahāya mṛṣāvādāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamaḥ siṃhavikrāntagāmī |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ siṃha vikrānta gāmī

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau surāmaireyamadyapramādasthānāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau surā maireya madya pramāda sthānāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamo dvātriṃśanmahāpuruṣalakṣaṇālaṃkṛtagātraḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ dvātriṃśat mahāpuruṣa lakṣaṇa alaṃkṛta gātraḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau nṛtyagītavāditralalitāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau nṛtya gīta vāditra lalitāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamaḥ śīlagandhānuliptagātraḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ śīla gandha anulipta gātraḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau gandhamālyavilepanavarṇakadhāraṇabhūṣaṇaṃ prahāya gandhamālyavilepanavarṇakadhāraṇabhūṣaṇāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau gandha mālya vilepana varṇaka dhāraṇa bhūṣaṇam prahāya gandha mālya vilepana varṇaka dhāraṇa bhūṣaṇāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: brāhmaṇa āha | kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautamaś catvāriṃśaddantasamanvāgataḥ suśukladantaḥ suśobhanadantaḥ sudīptadantaḥ | bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau vikālabhojanaṃ prahāya vikālabhojanāt prativirataḥ | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ āha kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ catvāriṃśat danta samanvāgataḥ su śukla dantaḥ su śobhana dantaḥ su dīpta dantaḥ bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau vikāla bhojanam prahāya vikāla bhojanāt prativirataḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: kiṃ śramaṇena gautamena pūrvakarma kṛtopacitaṃ yena śramaṇo gautama uṣṇīṣonnataśirāḥ |
analyzed: kim śramaṇena gautamena pūrva karma kṛta upacitam yena śramaṇaḥ gautamaḥ uṣṇīṣa unnata śirāḥ

original: bhagavān āha | ahaṃ mahābrāhmaṇa pūrvajanmopapattau buddhadharmasaṅghagurudakṣiṇīyācāryamātṛpitṛbhyaḥ pañcāṅgaṃ bhūmau nikṣipya namaskṛtavān | tasya karmaṇa etat phalam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha aham mahā brāhmaṇa pūrva janma upapattau buddha dharma saṅgha guru dakṣiṇīya ācārya mātṛ pitṛbhyaḥ pañcāṅgam bhūmau nikṣipya namaskṛtavān tasya karmaṇaḥ etat phalam

original: atha khalu dīrghanakhaparivrājako daṇḍakamaṇḍalu bhūmau nikṣipya bhagavantam etad avocat | eṣo 'haṃ bhadantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi dharmaṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ ca | aham api bhagavann imāṃ velām upādāya yāvajjīvam āryāṣṭāṅgikapoṣadham upavasāmi | sarvaprāṇivadhāt parasvaharaṇād abrahmacaryāt tathā vāgbhedād anṛtān madopajananāt pānād vikālāśanāt |
analyzed: atha khalu dīrghanakha parivrājakaḥ daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu bhūmau nikṣipya bhagavantam etat avocat eṣaḥ ham bhadantam śaraṇam gacchāmi dharmam bhikṣu saṃgham ca aham api bhagavan imām velām upādāya yāvajjīvam ārya aṣṭāṅgika poṣadham upavasāmi sarva prāṇi vadhāt para sva haraṇāt abrahmacaryāt tathā vāc bhedāt anṛtāt mada upajananāt pānāt vikāla aśanāt

original: mālāvarṇakanṛtyagītalalitāc chayyāsanād ucchritād adyāhaṃ virataḥ karomy arhatāṃ vṛttaṃ guṇair aṣṭabhiḥ ||
analyzed: mālā varṇaka nṛtya gīta lalitāt śayyā āsanāt ucchritāt adya aham virataḥ karomi arhatām vṛttam guṇaiḥ aṣṭabhiḥ

original: bhagavān āha | sādhu sādhu mahābrāhmaṇa etad eva karaṇīyam |
analyzed: bhagavān āha sādhu sādhu mahābrāhmaṇa etat eva karaṇīyam

original: atha khalu dīrghanakhaparivrājako mahābrāhmaṇaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti |
analyzed: atha khalu dīrghanakha parivrājakaḥ mahābrāhmaṇaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣad sa deva mānuṣa asura gandharvaḥ ca lokaḥ bhagavataḥ bhāṣitam abhyanandan iti

original: dīrghanakhaparipṛcchāsūtram ekādaśamaṃ samāptam |
analyzed: dīrghanakhaparipṛcchā sūtram ekādaśamam samāptam
